name: Context & Memory {OS}
tagline: The canonical shared context and persistence layer for every OS.

commands.name: /memory
commands.summary: Search or inspect memory, with provenance attached.

commands.name: /ingest
commands.summary: Ingest a file or event as a screened, hashed source.

commands.name: /context
commands.summary: Compile a purpose scoped context pack.

commands.name: /snapshot
commands.summary: Create an immutable versioned canonical state.

commands.name: /decision-log
commands.summary: Record a decision, its rationale and its review date.

commands.name: /contradiction
commands.summary: Open, inspect or adjudicate conflicting records.

commands.name: /memory-audit
commands.summary: Audit provenance, permissions, age and access.

commands.name: /forget
commands.summary: Correct, archive or delete authorized memory, with a receipt.

commands.name: /export-memory
commands.summary: Produce a human readable export of everything remembered.

requires_human_approval_for: canonicalizing an inference about the user they did not state themselves
merging two entities that might be different people, projects or accounts
sharing context across a project boundary
deleting a record another OS has cited
changing a retention policy or a permission scope
accepting a bulk ingestion whose source cannot be attributed
